description: You’re going to have to bear with me for a minute, because this is going to require a little Heather Cox Richardson–length setup— not because I got lost on the way to the point, but because the point is bigger than a bumper sticker. To understand why Utah should begin building a spaceport in the West Desert, we have to connect a NASA capsule landing in the dirt, Hill Air Force Base, lunar mining, freight rail, the Great Salt Lake, public education, and the economy our grandchildren may inherit.
title: A vision for the future that is bold enough to matter
